entities.name: Deborah
entities.description: One of the two speakers. A yoga teacher and community organiser who teaches classes, runs workshops and events, started a neighbourhood yoga class in March 2023, a running group with her neighbour Anna in July 2023 and a community cleanup project in August 2023. Married; her mother died a few years before 2023 and her father died suddenly on 25 January 2023, and much of what she says returns to her mother's old house, the bench in the park near her home and the pendant her mother left her. Keeps two cats, Luna and Max, dislikes dogs, surfs, gardens and jogs. Met Jolene on 23 January 2023 and they spoke roughly every few days through to 20 September 2023.

entities.name: Jolene
entities.description: The other speaker. An engineering student who finished an electrical engineering project in January 2023, built a sustainable water purifier for a rural community, was set a robotics project by her professor in February 2023 and finished it in May 2023, then took an internship at a well-known engineering firm reported in June 2023 and was working on a prototype aerial surveillance system by August 2023. Lives with a partner of three years whom she met in an engineering class; keeps two pet snakes, Susie and Seraphim; plays video games, practises yoga and meditation, reads, and wants to learn to surf. Her mother died in 2022.

entities.name: Deborah's mother

properties.aliases: Deborah's mom; my mum; my mother

entities.description: Deborah's mother, who died a few years before January 2023. She married Deborah's father in 1993. She read every night on a bench by the window of her house, loved travel, art, flowers and cooking, baked Deborah pineapple birthday cakes as a child, sang her lullabies, came to Deborah's first yoga classes with her and owned the cat Max. Deborah returns to her old house, to a bench in the park where the two of them used to talk, and to the pendant she left her.

entities.name: Deborah's father
entities.description: Deborah's father, who died suddenly on 25 January 2023, two days before she told Jolene about it. He married Deborah's mother in 1993.

entities.name: Deborah's husband
entities.description: Deborah's husband, never named. She says love and openness have kept them close, that they used to play video games together and preferred detective games, that they enjoyed being outdoors together, and that they married on a beach that is special to her. He went with her to her mother's house in July 2023.

entities.name: Anna

properties.aliases: Deborah's neighbour; my neighbor — the unnamed 'my neighbor' mentions of biking in April 2023 and the September 2023 gardening class are joined to her, as she is the only neighbour the conversation names

entities.description: Deborah's neighbour, met on 31 January 2023 at yoga in the park. She attends Deborah's yoga classes, wears a pendant in memory of her own mother, bought Deborah a vegan stir-fry, sat with her by the sea watching a sunset, started the running group with her in July 2023, heard her life story on 18 August 2023 and ran a free community gardening class with her on 16 September 2023.

entities.name: Karlie
entities.description: A friend of Deborah's who died in the week before 22 February 2023. Their last photograph together was taken on a hike in the summer of 2022. Deborah spent time in the garden for comfort after her death. Kept distinct from the friend Deborah speaks of on 30 August 2023 who wrote her a note, because she refers to that person as 'him'.

entities.name: Jolene's partner

properties.aliases: my partner; my boyfriend; my bf; he

entities.description: Jolene's partner, never named. They met in an engineering class at college, became friends and then a couple, and had been together three years as of February 2023; they are not married and the ring he wears is a decoration. They play video games together — Detroit, It Takes Two, Overcooked 2, Battlefield 1 — work on engineering projects together, and he has started joining her for yoga. Jolene bought him a games console on 17 August 2023. They travelled to Rio de Janeiro in August 2023 and to a meditation retreat in Phuket in September 2023, and took a scuba diving lesson on 15 September 2023. His father taught him to stay determined, and he pursues creative work.

entities.name: Jolene's mother
entities.description: Jolene's mother, who died in 2022. She gave Jolene a heart-shaped pendant in Paris in 2010, played video games with her — including Monster Hunter: World — and taught her never to give up and to value helping others, which Jolene carries into her engineering work. Jolene keeps memories of her own room in her mother's house.

entities.name: Nils Frahm
entities.description: A musician Jolene listens to during her yoga practice, named alongside Ólafur Arnalds on 28 March 2023 as calming music that puts her in a different headspace.

entities.name: Ólafur Arnalds
entities.description: A musician Jolene listens to during her yoga practice, named alongside Nils Frahm on 28 March 2023 as calming music.

entities.name: Susie
entities.description: One of Jolene's two pet snakes and the first she got — she adopted Susie in 2021 when she was feeling lonely and wanted company, and confirmed on 15 September 2023 that she had had her for two years. Jolene introduced her to Deborah on 27 January 2023 and said in August 2023 that Susie was a comfort after her project work was lost.

entities.name: Seraphim
entities.description: Jolene's second pet snake, bought in Paris in 2022. She once slid out of her cage and coiled up beside Jolene during a gaming session, went to the park with Jolene on 26 February 2023 where people were surprised to see a tame snake, and moved into a new aquarium Jolene bought on 24 June 2023.

entities.name: Luna
entities.description: One of Deborah's two cats, taken from a shelter, five years old as of 26 August 2023. Deborah says she takes her cats out to the park morning and evening.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: Deborah's other cat, eight years old as of 26 August 2023. He was her mother's cat and Deborah took him in when her mother died.

entities.name: Deborah's mother's old house

properties.aliases: my mother's old house; my mom's house; my old home; her old house

entities.description: The house Deborah's late mother lived in, and the place Deborah returns to most often. It has a bench by a window where her mother sat every morning for the view and every night with a book; Deborah sits there for yoga and for comfort, and there is a spot by the water nearby where she reflects on her mother's life. She visited it in the week before 23 January 2023, in July 2023, and again on 10 September 2023, and a yoga retreat she attended in August 2023 was near it.

entities.name: The park near Deborah's house

properties.aliases: the park near my house; a park with a forest trail; the nearby park; yoga in the park

entities.description: Deborah's favourite local spot, described as having a forest trail and a beach. She met Anna there at yoga in the park on 31 January 2023, jogged there for the first time on 24 February 2023, takes her cats there morning and evening, and it holds a bench where she and her mother used to sit and talk about dreams and life — she returned to it in August 2023 and brought flowers.

entities.name: Paris
entities.description: The city where Jolene's mother gave her the heart-shaped pendant in 2010, and where Jolene bought her second snake Seraphim in 2022.

entities.name: Bali
entities.description: An island Deborah travelled to in 2022 and named as one of her favourite trips — a gorgeous place that gave her peace and was good for yoga, including yoga on the beach.

entities.name: Bogota
entities.description: Where Jolene went on holiday in the summer of 2022; she took a photograph of the sunset over the water there and said it made her appreciate nature's calming power.

entities.name: Rio de Janeiro
entities.description: Jolene and her partner returned from a trip there on 29 August 2023, where they tried yoga classes, visited cafes, went on excursions and saw an old temple with striking stairs. Deborah says she was also in Rio de Janeiro in 2020 and photographed one of the excursions.

entities.name: Phuket

properties.aliases: Phuket; Thailand — Jolene refers to the same trip both ways

entities.description: Where Jolene and her partner went on a meditation retreat, travelling over the weekend of 9-10 September 2023. She described a session on releasing expectations and savouring the present as the one that stood out, and said on 15 September 2023 that they had tried a new style of meditation with flowers there.

entities.name: Mount Talkeetna
entities.description: The mountain where Jolene did yoga on the morning of 5 June 2023, shared with Deborah as an example of how she was trying to make time to unwind during her internship.

entities.name: Deborah's yoga classes

properties.aliases: my classes; the yoga class in the neighbourhood; my yoga group; the group members

entities.description: The yoga Deborah teaches: classes she was already running in January 2023, when the group sent her a thank-you letter, a neighbourhood class she first hosted for her neighbours on 10 March 2023, workshops and events on mindfulness and self-care, beach classes, and a community yoga event in July 2023 with food stalls and live music. She bought new props and candles for it in March 2023 and calls the people in it a second family.

entities.name: Deborah and Anna's running group
entities.description: A running group Deborah started with her neighbour Anna, reported on 9 July 2023. She says its members help and push each other during runs, which makes staying motivated easier.

entities.name: The engineering firm where Jolene interns

properties.aliases: a well-known engineering firm; my internship

entities.description: The unnamed firm where Jolene took an internship, reported on 6 June 2023. She said the best part was applying what she learned at school to real projects, that it stoked her love of engineering, and that work-life balance there was hard. By 24 August 2023 she was considering further internships.

entities.name: Jolene's engineering school

properties.aliases: engineering school; college; my studies; my engineering professor's course

entities.description: The college where Jolene studies engineering and where she met her partner in an engineering class. Her professor set her the robotics project in February 2023; she struggled with assignments in March 2023, with exams and deadlines through the spring, and had finals in September 2023.

entities.name: Sapiens
entities.description: A book Jolene was reading in February 2023, which she described as a fascinating look at human history and how technology has affected us.

entities.name: Avalanche
entities.description: A book by Neal Stephenson that Jolene read in one sitting about two weeks before 4 February 2023.

entities.name: Detroit
entities.description: A console game Jolene and her partner played together in the week before 27 January 2023.

entities.name: Walking Dead
entities.description: The game Jolene and her partner planned to play on Saturday 28 January 2023, having just played Detroit.

entities.name: It Takes Two
entities.description: Jolene and her partner's favourite game to play together, named on 9 July 2023 — a competitive team-strategy game they use to bond.

entities.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
entities.description: An open-world Switch game Jolene recommended to Deborah on 19 August 2023.

entities.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
entities.description: A game Jolene recommended to Deborah on 19 August 2023 as really calming and cute.

entities.name: Overcooked 2
entities.description: A chaotic co-op cooking game Jolene and her partner often play for bets; she once won three large pizzas on it.

entities.name: Battlefield 1
entities.description: A console game Jolene and her partner were given in the week before 21 August 2023.

entities.name: Monster Hunter: World
entities.description: One of Jolene's favourite games to play with her mother, praised on 3 September 2023 for its immersive story and open world.

entities.name: Sleep
entities.description: An album Deborah listens to and recommended to Jolene on 28 March 2023 as good for meditation and deep relaxation.

entities.name: Savana
entities.description: One of Deborah's favourite instrumental tracks for creating a peaceful atmosphere during yoga.

entities.name: Jolene's heart-shaped pendant
entities.description: A heart-shaped pendant with a bird on it that Jolene's mother gave her in Paris in 2010. Its symbol represents freedom to Jolene and reminds her to pursue her goals without being held back.

entities.name: Deborah's pendant from her mother
entities.description: A pendant, also called an amulet, that reminds Deborah of her mother. She brings it with her when she goes to the spot by the water near her mother's old house, and says holding it lets her feel her mother's love.

entities.name: Jolene's bullet journal
entities.description: The bullet journal Jolene started keeping in August 2023 to track tasks and stay organised. She finds crossing tasks off satisfying and keeps a favourite quote in it that reminds her to stick to her goals and never give up.

entities.name: The games console Jolene gave her partner
entities.description: A console Jolene bought as a gift for her partner on 17 August 2023, which he has been playing. They were given a new game for it, Battlefield 1, in the week before 21 August 2023.

entities.name: Yoga
entities.description: The practice at the centre of the conversation. Deborah teaches it, having taken it up when it helped her find peace during a rough time, and she runs classes, workshops, retreats and beach sessions. Jolene has practised it sporadically for about three years and uses it to manage study stress; her partner has started joining her. Poses named include Warrior II, a chair-supported twist, Dancer Pose, tree pose and savasana.

entities.name: Meditation
entities.description: Practised by both speakers. Deborah meditates every morning, made a meditation guide for her yoga retreat and led a session for elderly residents of a care home; Jolene meditates to regain clarity, signed up for a meditation course at a lakeside retreat on 6 September 2023 and went on a meditation retreat in Phuket with her partner.

entities.name: Video gaming
entities.description: Jolene's long-standing hobby: her parents gave her a console when she was ten, she taught herself to play, her mother played with her, and she now plays with her partner, sometimes for bets. Deborah used to play video games with her husband, preferring detective games, but had not played for a long time as of August 2023.

entities.name: Running
entities.description: Deborah went for a morning jog in the nearby park for the first time on 24 February 2023 and made it part of her daily routine; in July 2023 she started a running group with Anna.

entities.name: Surfing
entities.description: Deborah discovered her love of surfing at the beach where she married, and showed Jolene a photograph as proof on 17 September 2023. Jolene had wanted to learn since March 2023, gathering information and buying a beginners' guide, but had still not been by September 2023, when the two agreed to try it together.

entities.name: Gardening
entities.description: Deborah spends time in a garden of roses and dahlias for comfort, and on 16 September 2023 she and her neighbour Anna ran a free gardening class for the community that people of all ages joined.

entities.name: Reading
entities.description: One of Deborah's mother's hobbies — she read every night on the bench by the window. Jolene owns a large bookshelf, read Sapiens and Avalanche in early 2023 and a self-discovery book that resonated with her; Deborah also has a large bookshelf and values a space for escaping into a book.

entities.name: Jolene's robotics engineering project
entities.description: The large project Jolene's engineering professor set her, first described on 1 February 2023 as tough but fun. The mentions joined here are the robotics brief of February 2023, the 'engineering project' she found new solutions for at her February retreat, the breakthrough of 24 March 2023, the 'big project' she was watching take shape in April 2023 and 'the tough engineering project' she wrapped up in May 2023, which produced a solar-powered vehicle — the dates and the descriptions run consecutively and never conflict.

entities.name: Jolene's sustainable water purifier
entities.description: A sustainable water purifier Jolene designed and built for a rural community in need, reached as a major milestone in the week before 4 February 2023 after a lot of planning and research. Seeing it deliver clean water felt surreal to her and gave her a sense of purpose.

entities.name: Jolene's STEM volunteer programme
entities.description: Jolene's idea, put to Deborah on 9 February 2023, for a volunteer programme in which engineers teach STEM to underprivileged children through workshops with local schools and centres, with engineers as guest speakers. As of that date she had approached nobody, wanting to solidify the plan first, and kept sketches for it in a planner.

entities.name: Jolene's aerial surveillance prototype
entities.description: A prototype Jolene described on 12 August 2023 as something that could revolutionise aerial surveillance. Her aim is a more productive and affordable system that helps with emergency response and environmental monitoring.

entities.name: Deborah's community cleanup project
entities.description: A cleanup project for her community that Deborah started and raised funds for, reported on 1 August 2023. She said it was amazing to see everyone come together.

claims.text: As of 17 September 2023 Jolene had started learning about surfing but had never been, and she and Deborah agreed to go together, provisionally in October 2023 once they had settled on a time.
claims.speaker: Jolene

claims.text: Jolene's interest in surfing went from gathering information and getting a beginners' guide by 22 March 2023 to still not having been by 17 September 2023, when she and Deborah agreed to try it together.
claims.speaker: Jolene

claims.text: Deborah's friendship with her neighbour Anna developed from meeting her on 31 January 2023, through yoga classes together in February 2023, to starting a running group with her in July 2023 and running a free community gardening class with her on 16 September 2023.
claims.speaker: Deborah

claims.text: Deborah went to a music festival with friends shortly before 20 September 2023, loved dancing and the atmosphere, and said music reminds her of her mother's soothing voice singing her lullabies.
claims.speaker: Deborah

claims.text: Jolene and her partner went to a music festival in 2022, which she calls her way of expressing herself and getting away from everyday stress.
claims.speaker: Jolene

claims.text: Jolene said on 20 September 2023 that she and her partner had just got back from a yoga retreat where the sunrise lit up the sky during their practice and made them feel alive, grateful and connected to nature.
claims.speaker: Jolene

claims.text: Jolene once hiked with her partner to a waterfall oasis where her worries disappeared, and said on 20 September 2023 that she planned to get out into nature again in October 2023.
claims.speaker: Jolene

claims.text: A blossom tree near Deborah's home bloomed every spring, and she described watching it as admiring nature's artwork, filling her with awe and hope for growth even in tough times.
claims.speaker: Deborah

claims.text: Jolene said on 20 September 2023 that she finds inspiration in small things, such as a plant growing out of the corner of a building, which reminds her she can keep growing through any obstacle.
claims.speaker: Jolene

claims.text: Deborah lost both parents: her mother a few years before January 2023 and her father suddenly on 25 January 2023, and through 2023 she returned repeatedly to her mother's old house and to the bench in the park to stay connected to her.
claims.speaker: Deborah
